endpoint_id.description: Dotted identifier of the endpoint that was executed.

method.description: HTTP method used for the call.

path.description: Path actually requested, after path-placeholder substitution and query-string assembly.

body_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the bounded response body carried by the text content.

body.description: Response body parsed as JSON. Unconstrained: the shape is whatever the ComfyUI endpoint returned. Absent when the body was not JSON or was omitted.

body_text.description: Response body verbatim when it did not parse as JSON — ComfyUI's /view returns raw file bytes. Absent when body or body_omitted is present.

body_omitted.description: True when the body was left out of structuredContent because it exceeds the inline mirror budget; read it from the text content instead.
